text: Trying to add a first task is already a challenge. The suggested task can not be changed (even though the UI states it can), subtasks are added but appear part of a paid subscription to change. Trying to add a recurring task does not work, it just does not appear in the planner and not error either. The app is not intuitive at all.
author: Fam. Heidstra
developer_reply: Hello Fam. Sorry om the horen dat je moeilijkheden had met de app. Alle bugs zijn opgelost en de app zou nu moeten werken zonder problemen. Als je er toch een hebt kan je altijd hello@thruday emailen en dan kijk ik samen met jou. Thruday is volledig gratis, enkel een paar opties zijn premium zodat thruday blijft bestaan. Ik ben maar alleen. Andy

text: Great app, works very well for me. Where I previously had to use multiple apps alongside a notepad, I'm now able to condense it down to just one. I also find it helpful to see the next day in a bigger picture, which the web version allows me to do. I like the simple yet logical look and feel of the app, everything is straight forward and there aren't any visual distractions. Only thing I'd like to see is a setting which, when checked, auto completes a todo once all check boxes are ticked.
author: Matthijs Otten
developer_reply: Thanks for the positive review and feedback Matthijs and also, great suggestion. Andy is going to get to work on that feature over the next week and ensure it gets out.
